title: Range filter component audit
purpose: Audit range as its own component before adding more controls.
objective: Define range anatomy, switcher contracts, vertical/horizontal behavior, state matrix, responsive rules, and customization backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: label, min/max number inputs, slider handles, selected/base track, orientation, current value markers, scale ticks, units/prefix/suffix, responsive layout, generated HTML contracts, and Guilherme QA scenario. Out of scope: implementing fixes or auditing other types.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current range render/CSS/JS files are available.
exit_condition: A range audit sheet exists with mechanical bugs, product controls, deferred ideas, and QA scenario separated.
completion_criteria: Vertical and horizontal layouts are specified separately.
Track, handles, labels, ticks, and numeric inputs are first-class subelements.
State matrix and responsive behavior are documented.

phases.title: Anatomy
phases.purpose: Map render, CSS, JS, and screenshot evidence.

phases.title: Contracts
phases.purpose: Define switchers, states, layout reservation, and accessibility rules.

acceptance_criteria: Audit explains the vertical marker issue.
Audit separates mechanical bugs from product customization.
No plugin source changes are made.
verification: TASK-FC-006 validate_task passes with this child.
stop_conditions: Controls are proposed without anatomy-based justification.
